name: Chi Psi Tabling Event
description: Come learn about Chi Psi at their tabling event at Trone!

name: Panhellenic Family Weekend Tailgate
description: Panhellenic Council will be hosting a tailgate for the Family Weekend football game. We will be tailgating on Plyler Lawn, right on the Furman Mall. There will be Bucky's BBQ, desserts, and drinks. We will be selling tickets to freshman women and their families for $10/person the week of September 16th in the Trone Student Center. Pi Chis will be there to mingle! You can also have your parents mail a check made payable to Furman Panhellenic Council and mail it to: Furman Panhellenic Council, Trone Student Center, 3300 Poinsett Highway, Greenville SC 29613. If you have questions, please e-mail Danielle Bereznay at danielle.bereznay@furman.edu!

name: Kappa Delta Olive Garden Dinner
description: Kappa Delta is hosting it's annual Olive Garden Dinner in the Hartness Pavilion. It is 5 dollars for pasta, salad, breadsticks and desserts. Following the dinner at 7 pm, Mrs. Johnson from the Julie Valentine Center will be speaking about their program and how the students of Furman University can help in preventing child abuse. Come out and enjoy some food to support the Julie Valentine Center :)

name: Kick it With Kappa
description: Come join the sisters of Kappa Kappa Gamma for a fun workout and a chance to get to know Kappas!
